<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4H1Mzs/wbwriter/main/Assets/logo-mark-1024.png" width="72" align="right" alt="WBWriter">

### What's new

- **One black surface.** The area around the board is now almost as black as the board itself, with thin hatching in a barely different grey. The white border is replaced by a thin dark-grey line. From a distance the touchscreen looks like a single surface, and up close you can still tell where the board ends.

### Download

WBWriter 1.1.1 or later offers this update by itself at launch. Otherwise download **`WBWriter-1.3.2.dmg`** (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized), open it and drag WBWriter into Applications.

Linux and Windows are coming soon.
